purpose: Inspect one stored trip, its aggregate driving/charging totals, individual drive distances, metadata and ordered drive breakdown; optionally request a propose-only AI name.
primaryGoal: Understand the real trip and its constituent drives, retaining historical source trust, units, sorting/filtering/pagination, exports and recovery without inventing a map, telemetry or replay source.

dataSources.name: Stored trip detail
dataSources.behavior: Query key ['trips', id]; enabled for nonempty id; URL encodes the segment and forwards AbortSignal. Page derives historical DataState, separates fatal failure from retained refresh failure, and passes the query to shared freshness/source notices. Handler validates positive integer IDs and returns 400/404/500 with genuine source failure. DTO preserves nullable individual SI measurements and emits drives as [] rather than null.
dataSources.units: Raw total_distance_m/distance_m metres; total_energy_wh/energy_used_wh watt-hours; total_duration_s/duration_s seconds. Frontend uses useUnits, useFormatting and shared duration formatting only at display boundaries.

dataSources.name: Trip aggregates and drive order
dataSources.behavior: Two parameterized reads: trips/trip_drives/drives aggregates plus per-drive projection ordered by trip_drives.position. SUM coalesces missing drive measurements to zero in totals. Charge count and cost are vehicle-scoped overlapping charging-session window aggregates, not direct trip-charge membership. Open-trip aggregation uses NOW internally; wire end_date remains null. Backend comments claiming km/kWh conversion are stale: inspected handler emits SI unchanged.

dataSources.name: AI propose-only trip name
dataSources.behavior: AI visibility is governed by the existing auto-trip-naming feature gate. Undefined/blank/'0' ids disable request action; other IDs are trimmed and encoded. Stream identity changes abort prior-trip requests and clear previous output. The feature renders accumulated text and privacy-safe evidence; no mutation/save callback is supplied. Source route explicitly proposes only; actual provider availability and generated grounding were not exercised.

dataSources.name: Trip DTO and record identity
dataSources.behavior: Detail carries id, vehicle id, dates, total SI measurements, monetary cost, counts and per-drive fields. created_at is an alias of trip start time, not an audit creation timestamp. notes is consulted by the UI but is absent from this inspected DTO; preserve reachable notes if supplied without claiming current server notes support.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.contract: Existing shell width, header, breadcrumbs, route focus target, freshness and per-source notice; detail scope is record ID, not a second local vehicle/range picker.

components.name: TripKpiBand / TripOperationalBrief / OperationalBrief
components.contract: Six source-backed metrics: distance, energy, derived efficiency, duration, drives with charge context, cost. Scope/provenance/freshness/status and existing Review details drawer remain; useOperationalMetrics receives numeric raw sources.

components.name: TripDrivesChart / ChartCard / EmbeddedChart / ChartContainer
components.contract: Horizontal bars, source drive order, shared tooltip/axes/grid, adaptive bounded height, loading/empty/error, actual fallback rows/columns and PNG/SVG/copy-image export. No exportData means no chart CSV; EmbeddedChart defaults fullscreen false.

components.name: TripOverviewPanel / LayoutCard / KVList / DateTime
components.contract: ID, name, vehicle, start/end, in-progress state, duration, drive/charge counts, Created and meaningful notes; responsive key/value layout plus scoped skeleton/error/empty.

components.name: TripDrivesTable / DataTable / useSortToggle / RouteDisplay
components.contract: Route, started time, distance, energy, duration; stable trip table ID, raw-SI value filters, chronological API order until sort requested, sortable numeric/date fields, pagination, persisted column controls, inherited loaded matching-row CSV/JSON exports and shared sort announcements.

components.name: AIAutoTripNameSuggestion / AIFeatureCard / AiOutputPanel / withAiFeature
components.contract: Existing feature gating, Ask Helix accessible name, disabled/busy action, streaming/output/empty/error with evidence trail; no automatic persistence.

components.name: DataSourceNotice / DataState / FadeIn / QueryError / Skeleton / EmptyState
components.contract: Retained historical payload, fatal versus refresh error, paused/offline retry and non-destructive status. FadeIn respects reduced-motion preference.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Three domain sections repeat the same QueryError resource/list/retry composition. They already reuse shared primitives, and separate section recovery is intentional; no independent competing error system is evidenced.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep section-specific loading/error/empty behavior; only compose further if broader confirmed callers need it, not to shrink the page.

sourceBehavior.detail: Chart and overview stack below xl; xl uses a three-column grid with chart spanning two. All feature bands remain mounted.
Metadata identity has max-w-full and overflow-wrap:anywhere; shared layout is min-w-0 and full allocated width.
Chart height scales with drive count, bounded 220–520px, with 72px category axis and ResponsiveContainer.
AI header/title/actions wrap with min-w-0 and break-words rather than a fixed-width action row.

issues.detail: mobileColumns allows only route, started_at and distance_m. DataTable's mobile class hides energy and duration under md; the page supplies neither mobilePresentation nor row expansion. Column controls exist, but the inspected mobileSet still hides disallowed columns, so complete mobile access is not proven.
issues.fix: Adopt existing DataTable mobilePresentation with complete route/date/distance/energy/duration detail and equivalent filters/sort/export, or an explicit reachable details path. Do not delete secondary measurements.

issues.detail: A large drive count is compressed into a fixed 520px maximum with a 72px categorical axis and 10px axis ticks. This may skip labels or crowd bars on narrow allocations; actual overlap/overflow is unverified.
issues.fix: Test long trip counts/localized labels at narrow allocations; retain every drive in accessible rows/table/export and use bounded scrolling or existing responsive chart controls if needed.

positiveEvidence: KPI section has localized aria-label (TripKpiBand.tsx:89); role-based Text/KVList/DateTime are used.
Chart has localized ariaLabel plus actual data/dataColumns for shared screen-reader/forced-colors fallback (TripDrivesChart.tsx:47-58,80-88; ChartContainer.tsx:171-186,445-452).
DataTable exposes a stable table identity, shared sort announcement and pagination rather than raw controls (TripDrivesTable.tsx:137-146; DataTable.tsx:825-837,917-925).
AI action supplies a contextual accessible name and disabled/busy semantics; output error is role=alert (AIFeatureCard.tsx:304-311; AiOutputPanel.tsx:95).
Shared PageContainer supplies programmatic route heading focus; FadeIn uses shared motion preference (PageContainer.tsx:176-190; FadeIn.tsx:24-38).

issues.detail: chartAnimation contains static 800ms/ease-out only and is spread on BarChart, not the Bar series. The actual animated Bar has no isAnimationActive preference guard; shared chartAnimationProps already exists for Bar. Recharts runtime motion was not exercised.
issues.fix: Apply existing chartAnimationProps to Bar or the accepted shared series-motion contract, preserving all geometry/data; do not rely on CSS to stop JS animation.

issues.detail: Page supplies query and dataSources but no loading/busy/error props. PageContainer's load announcer reads loading/error, not query, and aria-busy reads loading/busy. Child skeletons/source notices exist, but equivalent page load completion announcements are unverified.
issues.fix: Wire non-destructive busy/announcement state or an existing scoped announcer while leaving section-level states and retained content intact.

issues.detail: Successful streamed name text is plain prose without a local live region. Errors are announced; action busy is exposed. Whether the evidence/thinking descendants provide equivalent completion announcements was not inspected.
issues.fix: Shared AI owner should validate and, if necessary, add concise preference-aware completion announcements without announcing every token or duplicating error announcements.

inventory.name: Initial loading
inventory.behavior: Contextual chart loading, overview/table skeletons, loading trip brief; headers and AI section are independently present subject to feature gate.

inventory.name: Fatal error / missing record / invalid id
inventory.behavior: Independent QueryErrors offer refetch and /trips recovery. Server distinguishes 400/404/500; no fabricated record is supplied.

inventory.name: Empty record or drives
inventory.behavior: Metadata explicitly says Trip not found for absent data; chart and table expose their own empty state. Disabled missing-ID query differs from a confirmed server 404.

inventory.name: Retained refresh failure
inventory.behavior: fatalError remains null with retained data; detail/overview/chart/table remain visible while brief/source notice report stale/refreshFailed and offer retry.

inventory.name: Offline/paused
inventory.behavior: Shared notice exposes paused offline or retained source status; exact paused-with-retained-data presentation requires runtime verification.

inventory.name: Open trip
inventory.behavior: Null end_date means In progress; stored record start and current aggregate window remain separate.

inventory.name: AI off/idle/loading/done/error
inventory.behavior: Off mode removes AI UI only. Bad placeholder IDs disable action; streaming disables another request; completed text/evidence remains; silent completion has explicit no-output copy; errors alert and can be regenerated.

issues.rule: MDC-026 unknown is not measured zero
issues.detail: Per-drive distance_m is nullable in both DTO and TypeScript. safeNumber turns missing/nonfinite values into zero, so accessible chart/export rows represent unavailable distance as numeric zero. Table filters retain null. This is an existing trust discrepancy, not permission to alter raw cache values.
issues.fix: Keep missing measurements null in presentation data and give the accessible/export representation an explicit unavailable value; retain all drive identities/order and distinguish a real zero bar.

issues.detail: safeMetric clamps negative/nonfinite totals to zero. Duration rawValue is null unless positive, so valid duration zero is presented as missing. The brief explicitly documents the current clamp policy; backend also coalesces missing drive totals to zero.
issues.fix: Preserve and document existing clamp behavior during modernization; coordinate explicit source availability/invalid metadata with the data owner before changing interpretation. Test zero, null, invalid and positive separately; do not rewrite raw SI values.

visualIssues.detail: ChartGradient hardcodes electric cyan #00f0ff with opacity 0.8, then applies its gradient to all distance bars. This is source-confirmed neon/saturated decoration despite no neon-class regex match. No rendered glow or contrast failure is claimed.
visualIssues.fix: Use the current semantic/chart palette with a subdued single-series solid or restrained existing fill, preserving distance comparison, tooltip, accessibility and exports.

visualIssues.detail: AI CTA and badge use fixed cyan border/background/text/focus accents. They are toned and theme-branched, not pure-white or proven glow, but add a second attention-heavy accent alongside the electric chart.
visualIssues.fix: Shared AI owner should apply existing semantic action/badge tokens and preserve branded identity, visible focus, busy state and names; do not invent a page-local AI visual system.

visualIssues.detail: Output panel uses bg-white/[0.02] rather than a semantic surface. This is low-alpha fixed-white decoration, not pure-white body text. Feature sources contain no direct text-white/#fff or glow classes in the executed bounded scan.
visualIssues.fix: Resolve the existing shared output surface through current theme tokens, retaining output/evidence/error/empty states; measure composed contrast in both themes.

visualIssues.detail: Started DateTime adds text-sm although its variant already owns formatting, and duration mixes Text size/color with role variants used elsewhere. This is source inconsistency, not a measured readability failure.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer existing typography role contracts while preserving date/duration precision and display preferences; avoid cosmetic shrinkage of dense mobile measurements.

architectureIssues.detail: Description instructs users to click Save, but this component passes only start/text/state/error to the shared card and supplies no save/confirm UI or callback. AiOutputPanel is a prose/evidence renderer, and backend route says persistence is out of scope. Current source does not establish a working Save action.
architectureIssues.fix: Track the mismatch with the AI/trip integration owner. Preserve propose-only generation and truthful output; do not claim save persistence or implement an invented mutation in presentation work.

architectureIssues.detail: Created renders created_at as if it were a creation audit date, but handler derives it from StartedAt because the schema has no audit column. Notes is conditionally rendered but absent from this DTO. These are real source-contract limitations.
architectureIssues.fix: Retain metadata and optional meaningful notes; clarify the created_at alias with the data owner rather than fabricating creation history or notes storage.

architectureIssues.detail: The computed route column renders RouteDisplay but supplies no exportValue. DataTable's fallback tries extracted rendered text, then row[column.key]; there is no route property in TripDriveSummary. CSV/JSON route serialization therefore needs explicit verification. Numeric JSON keys preserve raw SI while CSV prefers display text; no exportRawRows is supplied.
architectureIssues.fix: Supply source-backed route export values using start_place/end_place and preserve current loaded matching-row scope, raw SI JSON, display preferences and CSV behavior. Verify exact downloaded content; do not add a fake full-range export.

architectureIssues.detail: trip.name ?? fallback treats empty/whitespace names as valid identity, while overview uses trim and displays an em dash. A blank server name can leave metadata/breadcrumb/tab identity blank despite a loaded trip.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse a consistent nonblank name predicate for the displayed trip identity, preserving real names and Trip #id fallback.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature imports StatMetric through an implementation-specific stat-reference path. TripOperationalBrief also imports its props type from a concrete shared module. These are type-only couplings, not runtime competing renderers.
architectureIssues.fix: Consume accepted category type exports when available; coordinate missing public type exports with the shared owner without adding a replacement library.

priority.reason: Protect mobile access and null-vs-zero trust/export semantics first; then resolve AI Save claim and metadata provenance. Visual modernization must remove the electric cyan while preserving every source/action.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Existing DataTable mobile detail and export contracts
requiredSharedChanges.requirement: Prefer page adoption of current APIs; a new shared API is not established as necessary. Shared owner needed only if full mobile column reachability or source-backed export is unsupported. Do not create a second table/mobile renderer.

requiredSharedChanges.name: AI feature presentation and truthful proposal lifecycle
dependsOn: integration owner for absent Save action
requiredSharedChanges.requirement: Shared semantic styling and announcement validation belong to AI owners, not this page. Preserve propose-only behavior and privacy-safe evidence; backend persistence remains unresolved rather than inferred.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Existing chart and layout contracts, no new implementation
requiredSharedChanges.requirement: Current contracts support palette, motion, accessibility and image export needs. Page adoption should preserve capabilities; no new chart library, theme engine or fullscreen action is required.

competingImplementations.evidence: Page composes existing layout, operational brief, chart, table, formatting, feedback and AI owners. Local safeMetric is an explicit existing policy, not a second formatter. Type-only concrete imports and stale backend comments are coupling/documentation risks, not proof of duplicate implementations.
competingImplementations.scope: Bounded assigned page/dependencies only; no whole-repository duplicate audit.

preservation.sourceHashScope: Exact root-relative page file bytes, not a feature concatenation.
preservation.countInterpretation: Feature totals include page plus five inspected feature components. ChartCard and LayoutCard in the chart are alternative normal/fatal-error branches; shared OperationalBrief and AI card host additional surfaces not counted as feature-source tags. Zero direct GlassPanel/ChartContainer tags does not mean sections were deleted.

actions.name: Historical source retry/recovery
actions.preserve: Separate section feedback shares refetch; /trips recovery remains.

actions.name: Retained/offline source retry
actions.preserve: Nonfatal shared notice and retained historical content.

actions.name: Review brief details / close drawer
actions.preserve: Real raw-derived metrics, source scope, provenance, status and freshness.

actions.name: Chart tooltip and image export
actions.preserve: PNG, SVG and copy image with existing filename; no CSV without exportData; fullscreen is not enabled.

actions.name: Drive sorting/filtering/pagination/column controls/export
actions.preserve: Initial API order; sortable started/distance/energy/duration; raw-SI value filters; persisted table ID; all matching loaded rows CSV/JSON, not only current page.

actions.name: Ask Helix name proposal
actions.preserve: Feature gating, scope cancellation, busy/disabled, output/evidence/error/empty; no auto-save or invented persistence.

detailTelemetryMapReplay.detail: Present: trip overview, aggregate brief and individual drive table/chart.
detailTelemetryMapReplay.telemetry: No telemetry hook/panel/action in assigned page or its inspected feature components.
detailTelemetryMapReplay.map: No map/polyline component/action. Handler explicitly omits route_polyline because no per-trip source exists (handler.go:72-74). RouteDisplay is textual places, not a map.
detailTelemetryMapReplay.replay: App.tsx:642 registers replay at /drives/:id/replay, separate from this trip detail. This table has no row navigation/replay link callback; do not claim an existing replay action or silently remove adjacent route capabilities.
detailTelemetryMapReplay.preserveRule: Keep every evidenced action and specialist value. Missing map/telemetry/replay entrypoints are explicit source limits requiring separate authorized work, not permission to fabricate them or audit unrelated pages.

dataBehavior: Preserve root record-ID scope and query key, cancellation, enablement, inherited caching/retry, raw snake_case SI wire/cache values and display preferences.
Preserve per-drive nullability and trip_drives.position order; do not confuse loaded filtered rows with server total or chart full record.
Preserve charge/cost overlap aggregation, open-trip null end, total SI units and created_at alias truth; no fabricated charging association, trip polyline or telemetry.
Retain all six KPI metrics, counts/context, metadata and meaningful notes, independent chart/table/overview states and source trust.
Preserve existing nonnegative KPI clamp policy while documenting limitations; do not migrate units/backend math during presentation audit.
Keep table raw SI filter and JSON semantics separate from CSV display text; verify computed RouteDisplay export.
No source edits, route/settings changes, production request or mutation; no claimed runtime acceptance.

evidenceLimits.tests: Not run. No TypeScript, full-repository lint/build, source changes, Git or nested agents. Skill script inspected but not executed because it unconditionally invokes full frontend TypeScript; scoped regex counts executed instead.
evidenceLimits.routeEvidence: App.tsx:65,677 confirms lazy TripDetail mount at trips/:id under SafeRoute; runtime reachability/authentication/record existence not exercised.
evidenceLimits.visualLimits: No measured glow or contrast failure. Feature scan found zero inline styles/raw controls/direct library imports/text-white-or-hex-white/neon-or-glow classes. Explicit electric cyan gradient and shared low-alpha white surface remain source-evidenced separately.
